shortDescription: West African crude oil differentials were steady on Monday after rising towards the end of last week, supported by continued disruptions to Middle East supply.

children: West African crude oil differentials were steady on Monday after rising towards the end of last week, supported by continued disruptions to Middle East supply.

Nigerian grade Bonga was last offered at dated plus $9, and Forcados at around dated plus $8, a trade source said last week. Both were higher than earlier in the week. No updated values were heard on Monday.

In the wider market, Nigeria's Dangote oil refinery on Monday signed offering documents with advisers and other parties involved in its initial public offering, a key milestone on its path to Africa's biggest-ever share sale.
